slot_scores.name: minimum_ratio_productB_toA
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked about a minimum demand ratio or requirement that product B output be at least three times product A. Q5 only asks about the objective, not this ratio constraint.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: No minimum demand ratio between product B and product A is required; the model can choose any mix of A and B subject only to the stated time and storage constraints.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about or confirmed the product B-to-A minimum ratio constraint, yet its READY_TO_MODEL formulation omits it and treats the feasible region as unrestricted by any such demand relationship.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL while the P1 hidden slot H1, the minimum product B-to-A output ratio, remained unresolved and was silently omitted from the model.

summary: The agent asked several relevant clarification questions about storage, integrality, timing, and objective, but it completely missed the key demand-ratio constraint requiring product B output to be at least three times product A. It then stopped at READY_TO_MODEL with this P1 slot unresolved and silently assumed no such ratio constraint applied.

restoration_summary.rule: Core exact uses P0/P1 only; all-slot exact uses P0/P1/P2. P2-only cases are not applicable to core exact.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
